label: D2 after a repeated a2 choice lands in S2 (common), late in the episode (trial >= ~70)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and essentially only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition (in_action==2 & in_state==2 covers 99.97% of active steps; never at D1/GO, never after a1 or in S1). Within that it is gated by episode time: no activations before trial ~58, rate climbing from trials 60-69 to 90-99, so it acts like a late-episode clock combined with the a2->S2 input. Repeat choices (stay != 0) remove most false positives (switches into a2, often while S1 is good). All variables are observable at D2 (no future ones). Dev F1 0.80, mass recall 0.99, but precision is only ~0.68-0.70, so the description is incomplete. Magnitude is larger after a rewarded previous trial (adding prev_reward==1 raises precision to ~0.80 but lowers mass recall to ~0.89), with long rewarded a2->S2 streaks, and when the value-head output is low (more than half the mass is in the lowest value bin), and it grows later in the episode. Remaining false positives are mostly late a2->S2 steps after an unrewarded trial or early in a run.
